name: cgc-graph
description: Quartz 5 graph view: the pages around the current one, and the whole site behind a button, drawn on a canvas from an index this plugin publishes itself, with each page's date. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's, lightningcss is the parser Quartz reads CSS with, so a colour option passes exactly when Quartz would read it as a colour, and the utilities read a page's date exactly as Quartz does. The types are imported for types only.
//dependencies: @chaoticgoodcomputing/icons draws the icons the graph shows while the site builds, into the graph's index, with Iconify's packages, which can't all be inlined (svgo, under @iconify/tools, reads its data files at run time). So they stay out of dist/ and install here, at exactly the library's versions, which build.mjs checks (libs/icons/docs/adr/0001). MDI is one of them, pinned exactly, and by the workspace's lock: nothing is fetched.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, inlining our libraries and the browser runtime's d3 modules and tween.js, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships (build.mjs). The libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-graph
quartz.description: The graph view: the pages around the current one, and the whole site behind a button, drawn from an index with each page's date.
